description: This file is a Python script for managing and documenting BitBake variables, including functions for collecting documented variables, checking documentation tags, and processing variable references within the build system.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the script.

methods.name: bbvar_is_documented
methods.description: Checks if a variable is in the list of documented variables.

methods.name: collect_documented_vars
methods.description: Collects documented variables from documentation files.

methods.name: bbvar_doctag
methods.description: Retrieves the documentation tag for a variable from a config file.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that processes command-line arguments, collects variables, and reports undocumented variables.
